findingDetails.title: The turn-start.mjs module header names four parts while PARTS holds five, so the hand-over part added by e5b8611a4fa is undocumented where the ordering contract lives
The compaction test suite pins the watermark contract for the no-compaction case but not for the empty-section case, which is why the iteration-1 defect shipped
withdrawOnOperatorPrompt fires on any non-seed pre_agent without checking that the payload carries a prompt, contradicting the comment that justifies it

traceabilityChecks.notes: The session-lifecycle README describes the composer order; only the turn-start.mjs header is stale (R4-P2-001).
No agent profile in this dimension.

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new. R4-P2-002 sharpens the fix-completeness of R1-P1-001 by naming the missing test, so it counts as a refinement at 0.5x: weighted new = 1 + 1 = 2, weighted refinement = 0.5, weighted total = 2.5, ratio = 2.5 / 2.5 = 1.0.
ruledOut: The --remove-home fix being incomplete: run-conversation-scenario.cjs:1301-1315 makes the tree writable before rmSync, :3274-3275 records vibe_home_removed, and :3359 documents the flag
A stale compaction-post-tool.mjs or turn-end.mjs header: both were updated by e5b8611a4fa; only turn-start.mjs was missed
Dead code in the compaction detector: buildCompactionPart, buildPostToolPart and measureJournal all have callers
A missing test for the post-tool size gate: compaction-context.test.mjs:210-235 covers both the skip and the run; only the empty-text branch is uncovered
